name: Domino's Pizza, Inc.
note: US listed company (NASDAQ: DPZ), primarily a franchisor: about 99% of Domino's global stores are owned and operated by independent franchisees. Recorded during the Casa Pia research (issue #390); the Domino's brand is the shorts sponsor of Casa Pia's 2026-27 home kit. The Portuguese operation is a master franchisee, not identified in the 10-K.
